attack.motionSemantics: spring-loaded three-foot-supported forepaw arc; wind-up, fast curved swipe, recoil and recovery

idleHind.motionSemantics: neutral upright guard; planted hind paws, quiet breathing

walkHind.motionSemantics: alternating hind-leg shuffle; planted sole intervals, raised swing, counter-swinging forepaws

attackHind.motionSemantics: upright hind-paw-supported springy forepaw arc; returns to neutral upright guard

standUp.motionSemantics: four-foot crouch, forepaw release, pelvis rise and neutral hind-leg stance

standDown.motionSemantics: controlled return from upright guard to four-foot neutral; exact inverse pose path of standUp
